bill.title: An Act amending the act of March 4, 1971 (P.L.6, No.2), known as the Tax Reform Code of 1971, establishing the Returning Heroes Employment Tax Credit.

posted_text:
💰 PA HB 2877 — PA Offers $2,000 Boost for Returning Veterans' Taxes

Pennsylvania is launching a new tax credit for veterans – the Returning Heroes Employment Tax Credit – designed to help them manage their tax liability.

Eligible taxpayers, including businesses and S corporations, can claim a credit of up to $2,000 against their qualified tax liability.

The credit applies to veterans certified by the Department of Labor and Industry, and can be carried over to future years for a maximum of 15 years.

The program is capped at $20 million annually and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

This credit is particularly beneficial for shareholders of S corporations and owners of pass-through entities, allowing them to receive a portion of the credit based on their share of the business's income.

Oct. 21, 2026: Referred to Finance.
